verdict.rationale: Glama hosts and builds servers from GitHub repos, Dockerfiles, npm or PyPI artifacts, but every documented path starts from code that is already an MCP server. The evidence explicitly states the hosting page has no OpenAPI, convert, or scaffold capability, and its only OpenAPI document is for generating clients of its own directory API. Hosting existing MCP servers is adjacent to this story, not a way to avoid writing protocol plumbing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing
